about_code_licence: The Sheltr app is open source under the Apache License 2.0.
about_description: Sheltr is a free, non-profit guide to disaster preparedness and response. It answers only from approved official documents and shows the source of every answer.
about_disclaimer: Sheltr is an independent project. It is not an official government or agency service and it does not send alerts. In an emergency, follow the instructions of your local authorities.
about_privacy: Sheltr has no accounts, no analytics and no tracking. Your searches and settings stay on your device. The app does not use your location. Its only network request downloads updated guidance, and the app checks the digital signature of that content before using it.
about_sources_intro: Every answer comes from one of these documents. Each keeps its own licence.
answer_read_aloud_unavailable: Read-aloud isn't available on this device.
answer_refusal_body: Sheltr doesn't have reliable guidance on this yet. Try different search words, or contact local emergency services for urgent help.
error_start_body: The offline content could not be opened. Close and reopen the app. If this keeps happening, reinstall it.
search_placeholder: What do you need to know?
settings_language_notice: Language only changes menus and labels in this app. Disaster guidance content stays in its original language.
settings_mobile_data_hint: Off: automatic sync waits for Wi-Fi.
settings_sync_rejected_signature_message: Sync rejected: the published bundle's signature did not verify.
settings_sync_unavailable_message: Sync isn't available in this build.
